## TL;DR Reduced phone-only clutter across the UI without changing desktop layouts: explanatory page subtitles are hidden below 720px, the Work queue breadcrumb is gone, the integration pipeline hides only while genuinely idle (active, failed, stalled and no-check-plan states stay visible), Mission Control and the task-detail title now start at the left content edge, and the More bottom sheet uses the opaque `--panel-solid` surface in every theme. Focused regression coverage was added in `src/ui-app/tests/mobile-clutter.test.ts`; the scoped check and the rendered contrast audit pass. ## Work and rationale I worked from the five attached screenshots, which showed four separate phone problems: the Mission Control title pushed to the right, the More sheet with Settings text visibly bleeding through, the Work queue carrying a REPOOS / WORK kicker and an idle integration bar, and the task-detail title squeezed into a narrow column starting halfway across the screen. The code confirmed each had a distinct cause rather than one shared mobile defect. **Page subtitles.** I added one phone-width rule in `style.css` that hides the shared `.page-desc` plus the page-local subtitle classes used by views with their own headers: `.rel-sub` (Releases), `.ck-sub` (Checks) and `.dep-sub` (Deployments). Stories, Settings, Dev, Context, Inputs, Secrets, Agents and the loading shell all use `.page-desc`, so they inherit the same behaviour. The titles and every control remain. One exception is deliberate: Settings and Agents surface config save failures inline through `.save-msg.err`, so `.page-desc:has(.save-msg.err)` stays visible on a phone. Hiding a save failure would have removed status a user needs; hiding “Saved — applied live” does not. **Work queue and pipeline bar.** `MobileWorkQueue.vue` is only rendered at narrow widths, so I deleted the `REPOOS / WORK` `

` and its now-unused CSS rather than hiding it. The integration bar keeps its component mounted; `IntegrationStatusBar.vue` now adds `is-idle` only when the snapshot is idle and the check plan does not need attention. A phone-only rule hides `.ibar-wrap.is-idle`. Active, failed, stalled and queued states never carry that class. A genuinely empty check plan is actionable, so it remains visible, and the collapsed strip now says “No checks configured — open for details” with an amber dot instead of claiming the pipeline is simply idle. **Title alignment.** Mission Control had an inline `style="… align-items: flex-end …"` on its page header. Inline styles beat the existing `@media (max-width: 720px)` rule that turns `.page-header` into a left-aligned column, so the title and description were end-aligned and the subtitle overflowed. The inline block duplicated the base `.page-header` rules exactly; removing it restores both the desktop row and the phone column. For the task detail, the title column sat beside the 44px Queue button for the whole header, so a long title wrapped in roughly 290px. I added a `task-detail-head` hook, wrapped the mobile header, and ordered the back button and close control onto the first row while `.drawer-head-main` takes a full-width second row. I also removed its inline `flex: 1` and moved that declaration into the base CSS so desktop is unchanged. **More sheet.** `--panel` is intentionally translucent in the classic, gruvbox, catppuccin, hypercolor and solarized themes; that is good for glass cards over a controlled background, but wrong for a modal sheet over arbitrary page content. The sheet now uses `--panel-solid`, which every supported theme defines as an opaque surface. No backdrop-filter change was needed because the background is fully opaque. **Small follow-on.** The Stories header controls (checkbox plus a fixed 210px sort select) overflowed the phone header. They now live in a named class that wraps on narrow screens, keeping the long “Hide Completed Stories” label readable. ## Approaches tried I first considered hiding the kicker and idle bar with `display: none` selectors alone. The kicker was simplest to delete outright because the component is mobile-only. For the pipeline bar I rejected hiding based on “collapsed” (the bar can be expanded while idle) and based on a viewport check in JavaScript (CSS already owns the breakpoint). A state class from the existing snapshot was the smallest change: the component already knows idle vs active vs failed, and CSS owns the phone breakpoint. For the More sheet I rejected stacking `--panel` over `--bg` or adding a blur, because both still depend on what is underneath. Reusing the existing opaque surface token is the theme-native fix and automatically covers all light and dark variants. For the task-detail title I considered splitting the metadata row into the first flex line via `display: contents`, but that would have changed the title’s desktop structure and risked the in-place title editor. Reordering three established flex children with a task-detail-only class keeps new-task and other drawer headers untouched. ## Challenges and blockers The attached screenshots exist only in the main checkout’s ignored attachments, so I read them as reference images rather than from worktree source. I did not have a logged-in phone or a preview session. Verification therefore comes from the focused component and CSS regression tests, `vue-tsc` plus the UI build, the UI smoke test, and the 16-theme rendered contrast audit that runs in the check; I did not claim device testing that I did not perform. The check’s first run failed only on formatting in the new test; `bun run fmt` fixed it and the rerun passed every step. ## Key learnings Inline styles on shared layout classes silently defeat responsive media queries; the Mission Control header looked like a flex bug but was an override-order bug. Theme tokens carry intent: `--panel` means a translucent glass surface and must not be used for a sheet that sits over unbounded content. And “hide idle chrome” needs a precise definition of idle: an empty check plan is an attention state, so the hide rule must exclude it rather than key only on the snapshot’s `empty` flag. ## Generated change summary Base tree: `6f50f27750613e7491de1ae311f9d348e7ef2b7a` Source tree: `a044cc925cf259931be80715843315f2fd82a896` - M src/ui-app/src/components/IntegrationStatusBar.vue: +30 / −3 - M src/ui-app/src/components/MobileWorkQueue.vue: +0 / −7 - M src/ui-app/src/components/TaskDrawer.vue: +2 / −2 - M src/ui-app/src/style.css: +48 / −1 - M src/ui-app/src/views/DashboardView.vue: +1 / −9 - M src/ui-app/src/views/StoriesView.vue: +14 / −1 - A src/ui-app/tests/mobile-clutter.test.ts: +155 / −0
